original_test_intent: Exercise double-precision GEMM concurrently on all GPUs for the configured 60 seconds and verify RVS/GST completes within approved compute, thermal, power and platform-health criteria.
original_method: Create a reviewed copy of the exact DGEMM configuration, validate it, run one RVS GST pass while collecting full periodic output and system telemetry, then correlate completion and errors with the project specification.
manual_activity: Operator supervises the all-GPU load and OOB recovery; engineer resolves shared identity, specification and stress anomalies and decides the DUT verdict.
required_inputs: Approved ROCm Validation Suite/GST version and config schema
Maintenance, workload isolation and evidence path
Cooling/power/thermal/timeout abort limits and OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Checksum/back up the installed config and use a reviewed temporary copy
Validate every field before load and drain all conflicting workloads
Continuously monitor cooling, power, temperature, ECC, PCIe/XGMI and driver health
Stop on config, device, timeout, RVS/GST, fan, thermal, power or platform error
Preserve full results and return every GPU to the approved idle envelope
agent_execution_scope: Validate the exact source DGEMM parameters in a non-destructive config copy
Run one approved 60-second RVS pass and retain complete output/status
Collect per-GPU telemetry and correlated platform logs throughout
Do not edit the only config, truncate results, repeat automatically or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve RVS/GST/config, target GPUs, criteria and load/recovery policy
Resolve any compute/telemetry/log issue and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run `/opt/rocm/bin/rvs -c <reviewed-dgemm-config>` exactly once after schema and safety approval, preserving complete stdout/stderr/exit and 5-second periodic evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All DGEMM scalar, matrix/stride 28000, device-all, 60000-ms duration, 5000-ms logging, parallel, target_stress 70000 and source 20/30 timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat the run as a parameter-locked all-GPU stress transaction with config hash, per-device telemetry, full RVS phase/results and explicit first-fault abort/recovery evidence.

modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Row416 log scrubbing remains independent; lack of a dmesg error alone is not DGEMM success.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Target_stress semantics and project acceptance thresholds depend on the approved RVS version and platform recipe.

Target GPU/BDF map, workload isolation and critical approval

Return-to-idle, abort/recovery, identity disposition and engineer verdict

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve duplicate code Wistron-AMD GPU-00135-V002 between Compatibility row150 variant 681b8b27e6db3f12 (RVS GST DGEMM all-GPU 60-second stress) and row416 variant 51ad508a8c292dca (dmesg error scrubbing): assign distinct identities without merging coverage; for row150 approve the RVS/GST version/schema, exact target map and performance/error oracle plus workload isolation, cooling/power/timeout abort and OOB recovery policy.

review_improvement: Corrects the read-only misclassification and turns a tail-only launch into a parameter-locked, fully observed and recoverable all-GPU DGEMM run.
independent_technical_reasoning: Large 28000-square double-precision matrices and device-all parallel execution are sustained compute and memory stress, even when duration is only 60 seconds. Successful process exit is insufficient if one GPU throttles, drops, accumulates ECC/link errors or the result log is truncated. Config identity and full per-device health must accompany the RVS verdict; dmesg scrubbing tests another function.
